# youtrack_custom_field (Resource)

Manages a global custom field prototype. Use `youtrack_project_custom_field` to attach it to a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "youtrack_custom_field" "customer" {
  name                       = "Customer"
  type                       = "enum[1]"
  is_displayed_in_issue_list = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the custom field.
- `type` (String) Field type, for example `enum[1]`, `state[1]`, `user[*]` or `string`. `[1]` stores a single value, `[*]` multiple values. Changing it recreates the field.

### Optional

- `aliases` (String) Comma-separated aliases that can be used in commands and queries.
- `is_auto_attached` (Boolean) Whether the field is attached to new projects automatically.
- `is_displayed_in_issue_list` (Boolean) Whether the field is shown in the issue list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the custom field.
